title: The Dynamics of Intelligence Explosions
abstract: arXiv:2608.14426v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI is increasingly being used to help with AI R&D. Under certain conditions this feedback loop might be able to produce an intelligence explosion, with rapidly escalating AI capabilities. I explore the mathematics of the most explosive possibilities, with an eye to understanding what drives the dynamics. I show that singular growth (towards a vertical asymptote) is harder to achieve than would be expected from recent economics-inspired modelling, and that there is an important but neglected class of growth rates that are faster than exponential but don't lead to a vertical asymptote. I draw out the generation time (the time to go around the feedback loop) as a neglected parameter that plays a pivotal role in determining the behaviour of any intelligence explosion --- one cannot have singular growth unless the generation time rapidly approaches zero.

translated_abstract: 人工智能正越来越多地被用于辅助AI研发。在某些条件下，这种反馈循环可能引发智能爆炸，导致AI能力迅速升级。我探讨了最具爆炸性可能性的数学原理，旨在理解驱动其动态的关键因素。研究表明，奇异增长（朝向垂直渐近线）比近期受经济学启发的建模所预期的更难实现，并且存在一类重要但被忽视的增长率，它们快于指数增长但不会导致垂直渐近线。我提出了生成时间（完成反馈循环所需的时间）作为一个被忽视的参数，它在决定任何智能爆炸行为中起着关键作用——除非生成时间迅速趋近于零，否则不可能实现奇异增长。
tldr: 本文通过数学分析揭示了智能爆炸中生成时间的关键作用，指出奇异增长需要生成时间迅速趋近于零，且存在比指数增长更快但不导致垂直渐近线的增长率类别。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals the pivotal role of generation time in intelligence explosions through mathematical analysis, showing singular growth requires generation time rapidly approaching zero, and identifies growth rates faster than exponential but without vertical asymptotes.
